content: Paramount is appointing a new co-CEO ahead of the close of its $110 billion merger with Warner Bros. Discovery. Ynon Kreiz, previously Mattel’s chairman and CEO, will be joining Paramount to lead alongside chairman and CEO David Ellison. According to Paramount, “Ellison will focus on the company’s long-term strategy, creative vision and direction, including its talent relationships, strategic partnerships, technology and capital allocation. Kreiz will focus on the company’s day-to-day management and integration of the combined businesses.” The combined Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery will “report jointly” to Ellison and Kreiz.  Kreiz joined Mattel in 2018. While he was leading the company, it launched the hit Barbie film in partnership with Warner Bros. Pictures. His first day at Paramount is October 5th. Today, a judge also approved Paramount’s recently-announced settlement in a lawsuit with several states that had been blocking the Warner Bros. Discovery merger, according to Reuters. On Tuesday, Paramount’s streaming chief, Cindy Holland, announced that she would be stepping down, and Variety reports that HBO boss Casey Bloys is “poised” to take over both Paramount Plus and HBO.

chineseContent: 派拉蒙公司将在与华纳兄弟探索公司 1,100 亿美元的合并交易完成之前任命一位新的联合首席执行官。美泰公司前董事长兼首席执行官伊农·克雷兹 (Ynon Kreiz) 将加入派拉蒙，与董事长兼首席执行官大卫·埃里森 (David Ellison) 共同领导。派拉蒙表示，“埃里森将专注于公司的长期战略、创意愿景和方向，包括人才关系、战略合作伙伴关系、技术和资本配置。克雷兹将专注于公司的日常管理和合并后业务的整合。”合并后的派拉蒙和华纳兄弟探索公司将“联合”向埃里森和克瑞兹汇报。  Kreiz 于 2018 年加入美泰。在他领导公司期间，该公司与华纳兄弟影业合作推出了热门芭比娃娃电影。 10 月 5 日是他在派拉蒙的第一天。据路透社报道，今天，一名法官还批准了派拉蒙最近宣布的与几个一直阻止华纳兄弟探索合并的州的诉讼和解。周二，派拉蒙的流媒体主管辛迪·霍兰 (Cindy Holland) 宣布她将辞职，《Variety》报道称 HBO 老板凯西·布洛伊斯 (Casey Bloys) “准备”接管派拉蒙 Plus 和 HBO。
